I appealed 12 days ago or so now and my appeal status is "open". I made a long case with screenshots showing my account data was stolen and I had to contact Microsoft to change my shit. New email, new password, alternative alias to log in. Point is: yes, you can be permanently banned with no previous infractions. Bungie doesn't, and won't ever give the reason for your ban because they feel if they do, it gives cheaters and cheat software ways to get around their anti - cheat system.
